coverage.scope: Reviewed partial chart transcription: all twelve visible boxes, five continuous box-to-box connectors and four unknown records. Six detached icon-origin segments have no declared source box; their semantics remain unresolved.
included: Twelve visible chart boxes inventoried as nodes: one stage/checkpoint (WALKING IN THE PARK), ten actions and one outcome (MARKUS TOOK THE BUS).
Exactly five continuous traced box-to-box edges: park→store, store→package, package→bus, vendor→pushed and preacher→yells.
The six detached icon-origin segments are recorded only as unknowns: they start at five icons rather than the declared boxes (the magazine icon is shared) and are NOT invented as edges.

Four unknown records: detached-segment origins, absence of a universal ordering or optional-eligibility rule beyond the five traced edges, the harassment proximity/eligibility and later Painter consequence, and the platform/game build.
Reference-only rights state for both sources, with a Steam removed-item notice despite the accessible page and images.
omitted: The six detached icon-origin segments are not modeled as edges; no edge is invented from an icon to its apparent target.
Icon legend semantics: legend meanings are not interpreted or packaged.

Unshown branches, cross-chapter claims and the cross-chapter edge to Carl's later comment in The Painter: guide list ordering does not support chart connections; no cross-chapter edge or exact trigger is modeled.
Harassment causal edge: the exact proximity/eligibility and the later Painter consequence are unverified; no causal edge is added.
Percentages and any completion claims: partial coverage does not claim complete gameplay. The reviewed slice is integrated separately into the runtime.
Source images: no image content is reproduced or packaged.
Gameplay verification, platform and game version: no transition is verified in game and the build is unknown.
Publication rights: all sources remain reference-only; no reuse license, clearance or permission is asserted, and publication clearance is omitted.
